question: Which of the following temple of Thanjavur has chola architecture and was built by Emperor Rajaraja?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Brihadisvara Temple**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Thanjavur's Brihadisvara Temple**

 
 
• **It is a Hindu shrine dedicated to Shiva.**
 
• **It is one of the largest temples in South India and a model of fully realised Tamil architecture.**
 
• **It was built between 1003 and 1010 AD by Raja Raja Chola I. Hence, Option 4 is correct.**
 
• This 11th-century temple's initial monuments were built around a moat.
 
• It contained the gopura, the main temple, its high tower, as well as inscriptions, frescoes, and sculptures primarily associated with Shaivism, but also Vaishnavism and Shaktism Hindu traditions.
 
• The temple has been damaged during its history, and some artwork has been lost.
 
• In the centuries that followed, more mandapams and monuments were built.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gavi Gangadhareshwara Temple**

 
 
• Gavi Gangadhareshwara Temple is also known as Gavipuram Cave Temple.
 
• It is an example of Indian rock-cut architecture. 
 
• This cave temple is dedicated to Shiva and cut into a monolithic stone.
 
• It is located in Bangalore, Karnataka. 
 
• It was built in the 16th century by Kempe Gowda I, the founder of the city.
 
 
 
• **Ranganathaswamy Temple**
 
 
• Dedicated to Vishnu, the temple of Srirangam's vast complex has seven enclosures formed by huge rampart walls and 21 elaborate towers.
 
 
 
• **Venkateswara Temple**
 
 
• This temple has Lord Balaji as presiding deity and the Lord here almost resembles the Lord at Tirumala temple. Located in a village about 20 KMs from Tirupati, this temple also attracts lots of pilgrims. This is also an ancient temple with history.
